main_text.l: ἀπηλιώτης, est, quando stella Sole exoriente
ἐπαωα τολὴ, cum post Solis exortum stella
τολή, quando stella exortu suo emersiuè Solem
tur, hunc ἐπιτολὼ Poëtæ proprie uocant, prio-
res duas species sub ortu cosmico complectuntur.
πρωινὸς λιψ, quando Sole oriente stella è
ἐπικατάδυσις, cum stella Sole iam euecto,
ἑώα συγκατάδυσις ἀληθινὴ, cum eodem momento, quo Sol
OCCASVS matutinus precedens, ἑώα πρὸ δυσις.

page.notes: The last line of the page is partly illegible in its Greek portion; the final word "δυσις" is read from the signature area and may be incomplete. Greek accents in several words are uncertain and transcribed as best read.
